item.title: No Music? No Empathy? No Thanks!
item.description: Read No Music? No Empathy? No Thanks! Manager: "You were on your cell phone for seventeen minutes last night. You know that’s not allowed. Now sign this and clock in, or I have to let you go." She has this cheerful little I have authority to treat you like s*** smile. I grab my stuff. Me: "I quit." Read No Music? No Empathy? No Thanks!

item.title: Don’t Vape Me Say It Again
item.description: Read Don’t Vape Me Say It Again Me: "Sir, you cannot vape in here! That is against the law." Passenger: "I wasn't vaping!" Me: "Oh, my apologies, sir, that must have been a cloud I saw. You can understand my confusion, as usually those are outside the plane." Read Don’t Vape Me Say It Again

item.title: A New Form Of Manual Labor
item.description: Read A New Form Of Manual Labor Coworker: "You need to ask ol' Sal for that." Me: "Okay, thanks—" Coworker: "—wait. You can ask him, but wait until you have some time to kill… and don't question his methods. Ever." Read A New Form Of Manual Labor

item.title: The Seat of His Anger
item.description: Read The Seat of His Anger Customer: "They got you sitting down at the registers now, I see?" Me: "Well, there really was no reason why we had to stand for eight hours a day, so—" Customer: "—You should be grateful to have a job! Lots of other people are willing to stand all day to have a job!" Read The Seat of His Anger

item.title: Cart-ing Them Off To Jail
item.description: Read Cart-ing Them Off To Jail Two women come in together. Each has a baby in their cart. One cart is normal. The other is overflowing, and I mean overflowing, with DVDs (yeah, this story is old). They loop the store for a bit. Then one of them picks up an activated security tag from a shelf, but steals nothing. They head for the exit together. As they push through the doors, the alarm blares. Read Cart-ing Them Off To Jail
